predicates.label: Goal
predicates.description: What the owner wants to learn this topic for, in their words

predicates.label: Deadline
predicates.description: Date by which the owner wants to have seen every card of the topic, at noon local time

predicates.label: Language
predicates.description: Language of the topic's cards, as the owner asked (e.g. es, en)

predicates.label: Topic state
predicates.description: active, paused or archived

predicates.label: Topic
predicates.description: The topic a unit or a card belongs to

predicates.label: Order in the plan
predicates.description: Position of the unit in its topic's study plan, from 1

predicates.label: What the unit covers
predicates.description: What the unit of the plan is about, so its cards can be made when it comes up

predicates.label: Unit
predicates.description: The unit of the plan a card belongs to (none for cards from the conversation)

predicates.label: Question
predicates.description: What the agent asks

predicates.label: Answer
predicates.description: What a good answer must contain, used to grade the owner's words

predicates.label: Origin
predicates.description: conversation (the owner said it), material (from a text the owner gave) or plan (from the agent's knowledge, for a unit of the plan)

predicates.label: Where it came from
predicates.description: The owner's words, the title of the material or the unit, so a wrong card can be traced

predicates.label: Sequence
predicates.description: Order in which the card was added, so new cards are introduced in that order

predicates.label: Card state
predicates.description: active, paused or archived

predicates.label: Desired retention
predicates.description: Probability of remembering a card when it is asked, e.g. 9000 = 90%

predicates.label: Session length
predicates.description: Minutes of a daily session

predicates.label: New cards per day
predicates.description: Most cards seen for the first time in one day

predicates.label: Streak freezes per month
predicates.description: Missed days per calendar month that do not break the streak

predicates.label: Rating
predicates.description: FSRS rating of a review: 1 again, 2 hard, 3 good, 4 easy

predicates.label: Attempt
predicates.description: 1 for the first time a card is asked that day, 2 when it is asked again after a miss

predicates.label: The owner's answer
predicates.description: What the owner answered, in their words

predicates.label: Card
predicates.description: The card a review or a reset is about

predicates.label: Reason
predicates.description: Why something was changed, in the owner's words
